workout.warmup: Your 15-min walk to the gym IS your warmup — no treadmill needed. But DO ramp-up sets on the leg press (a light 8, then a medium 5) before the heavy work.
workout.finisher: Your 15-min walk home. No treadmill finisher needed.
workout.coach_note: Thursday rest, Friday your big walking day, this Saturday = legs get 4 days off since Tuesday and stay fresh for heavy work. (If Friday's walk had real hills, push this to Sunday.) TWO CHANGES from Day 1: (1) DB RDL is out — PF dumbbells cap at 75 and your grip failed there, so the hinge moves to the SMITH MACHINE where you can actually load it. Use straps if they've arrived. (2) Leg curl drops to 65 (70 broke down to 6 reps on set 3) and leg extension goes up (60 was too easy). Main lifts heavy 4x6, accessories 10-12.

exercises.name: Leg Press [HEAVY]
exercises.detail: 450 lb plates (+167 sled) · 4 x 6 · 2–3 min rest
exercises.note: MAIN LIFT. On 7/14 you jumped to 450 in plates and got 6 — tough. Stay at 450 and own all 4 sets of 6 this time. Do 2 ramp-up sets first (360 x8, then a medium 5). If you clear 6 clean on every set, add next session.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift [HEAVY]
exercises.detail: 4 x 6 · 2–3 min rest · straps if you have them
exercises.note: MAIN LIFT — replaces DB RDL. PF DBs stop at 75 and your grip gave out there, so the bar solves both. Ballard's Smith bar is labeled 25 lb — load to roughly 135–155 total and adjust so 6 is hard but clean. Hinge from the hips, soft knees, flat back, bar close to the legs, feel the hamstring stretch. Straps if they've arrived.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: Dropping from 70 — you only got 6 on set 3 last time and had to strip to 60 mid-set. 65 should let you hold 10–12 across all three. Keep that squeeze-and-hold at the contraction, that was a good cue.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: 60 was too easy (10 clean on every set). Go up to 70–75. Squeeze at the top, slow negative.

exercises.name: Core Circuit (fresh combo) — 2 rounds
exercises.detail: Cable Crunch x12 → Bicycle Crunch x24 → Side Plank 45–60s/side
exercises.note: Different from your last two circuits. Side plank per your own note — you're holding a minute easily, so 45–60s is the range now. Skipping hanging knee raises here since your grip is already taxed by the RDLs.
